caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt with a complex central geometric pattern, mainly composed of diamond shapes in concentric rings radiating outwards from the center in a starburst or radiating pattern. The colors of the diamonds include shades of blue, green, yellow, orange, red, and white, arranged in order to form a visually striking gradient effect. Surrounding the central star, there are four dark blue square sections, each featuring floral motifs composed of green stems and yellow blossoms with red centers, arranged symmetrically. A yellow zigzag pattern on a red band acts as an inner border, followed by a wider dark blue border and an outermost off-white edge. The upper right corner of the quilt is folded over, revealing a brown backing with a subtle swirl pattern. The composition is symmetrical and the quilt is illustrated as lying flat with clear, defined edges.
title: Star of Bethlehem Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
